Long, wavy sea-foam green hair with side-swept bangs and a glossy texture. Soft, turquoise eyes with a gentle, dreamy expression. Apparent age of nineteen with a soft, youthful maturity. Slender, delicate build. A white and light-blue summer dress with ruffled edges and nautical gold accents. A wide-brimmed straw hat with a blue ribbon and small floating water-based rigging.
BODY COLOR: fair
